name: com.plainerror/plainerror
title: PlainError
description: Plain-English fixes for Windows, PC games, and code. Search or paste an error. No account needed.

tools.name: explain_error
tools.description: Paste an error message (Windows, a PC game, or code). Returns a plain-English summary, ranked causes, safe-first fix steps, and the canonical plainerror.com URL. Reuses published or cached answers first. New answers share the website's limits: 10 new answers per IP per day, a site-wide daily AI spend cap, and a 20,000-character paste cap. Read-only from the client's point of view; no account needed. When the published steps don't resolve an issue, results include an optional paid Guided Fix the user can choose.

error_text.description: The full error message or log, exactly as it appears.

tools.name: search_fixes
tools.description: Search PlainError's published plain-English error fixes. Uses the same matching as the website search box. Returns titles, one-line summaries, and canonical URLs (at most 10).

query.description: Search words or an error code, e.g. 0x80070005 or mysql 1045.

limit.description: Maximum number of results (1–10). Defaults to 10.

tools.name: get_fix
tools.description: Return the full Markdown for a published PlainError page (or the Windows Update or blue-screen stop-codes hub). Pass a full plainerror.com URL, a path like /windows/0x80070002-windows-update-error, or a page slug. When the published steps don't resolve an issue, results include an optional paid Guided Fix the user can choose.

url_or_slug.description: Canonical URL, path, or slug of a published fix.
